successFields.contentState: draft for this controlled read; not published admission
successFields.contentRevision: safe frozen binding revision; not private definition digest
successFields.sourceTeachingNodeRef: Node7 binding; not current cursor claim
successFields.executionBlockId: manifest-bound Activity block; not current visual position
successFields.currentTeachingNode: null when no fresh authoritative cursor exists
successFields.currentPositionAvailability: unavailable or available with separate authoritative source
successFields.completionStatus: COMPLETED | INCOMPLETE; UNKNOWN maps to unavailable without successful completion fields
successFields.nodeProgress: null on proven empty baseline, else status/completionPercent/masteryScore/attemptCount
successFields.evidence: bounded subset of existing activity-completion/2 evidence
successFields.revision: ta1 state ref derived from scoped durable evidence, not source content revision
successFields.evidenceRefs: bounded durable_activity_completion ref with scope/Activity/snapshot/state revision
successFields.completeness: partial if current cursor unavailable; durable completion can still be verified
successFields.truncated: false; reject oversized output instead of truncating numerical facts

dataSelection: strict allowlist; no raw repository spread
snapshotAtomicity: receipt + attempt summary + progress fields projected from same successful validated repository READ ONLY snapshot; never two unrelated reads merged

errorRules.unknownReceipt: unavailable; do not convert attemptNumber=0 from UNKNOWN into proven empty state
